notes.title: You're invited to the Open Beta for Rakuen's New Engine!
notes.content:
[h2]New Engine Open Beta![/h2]

Hi everyone! I'm super excited to announce that we've spent the last year creating an entirely new custom-built engine (powered by Ebitengine) that will solve many of the issues inherent to RPG Maker XP while enabling us to bring Rakuen to other systems (like Switch and mobile devices) + some other goodies! [b]The new build is now in open beta and available to anyone who owns the game![/b]

[h3]🌳Update Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overall improved performance
[*]Resizable window & borderless windowed fullscreen mode
[*]No more blurring of pixels when the game window is expanded--nice, crisp pixel art!
[*]Steam Deck compatibility (with improved controller/touchscreen support)
[*]Fixed the RPG Maker XP issue where clicking off the game disrupts audio-synchronized cutscenes
[*]Steam Achievements now compatible with Mac/Linux/Steam Deck
[*]On-screen lyrics subtitles for translations
[*]New art, character animations, and smoother graphics.
[*]Original build will still be accessible to those who are using older machines.
[/list][h3]🌳Improved Livestream Experience:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pixel perfect game window resizing for StreamlabsOBS (or other streaming software)
[*]Audio-synchronized cutscenes will no longer be interrupted by stream alerts
[*]Streamers can switch tabs to chat on Twitch (or other platforms) without window issues
[/list]
[h3]🌳Accessing the Beta/Reporting Bugs:[/h3]
Because we want to ensure the best player experience possible, we're inviting all those who own the game to test the new engine before it's fully released. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/4/]If you find any bugs, please report them in our Official Bug Forum.[/url] If you'd like to participate in the open beta, here's how you can access it: Right-click Rakuen in your Steam library. Go to "Properties" and click the "Betas" tab. From the drop-down menu, select "you-beta-test-this" and that's it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27110155/f812804311f40ffc03472055b2cc104df5ad4fe6.png[/img]

If you already own Rakuen, then this update will be [b]completely free to you[/b] (and will be available automatically once it's released)! Starting this Monday (2/13), in order to cover development costs for building the new engine, Rakuen's price will become 14.99. But of course, anyone who has the game by then will receive the update & new engine for free.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/?utm_source=stm
Lastly, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/]don't forget to check out the demo for Mr. Saitou (the next game in the Rakuen universe)[/url] before the end of Steam Next Fest (and to Wishlist & Follow for updates, contests, etc.) ❤️

Mr. Saitou is a short game about an average white-collar worker who struggles to find meaning in a life full of constant overtime and social isolation. [h3]🌳Upcoming PC Update[/h3]
Rakuen will be receiving a major update, including a new custom-built engine powered by Ebitengine. I'm particularly excited about this because it will solve some of the issues that are inherent to RPG Maker XP. notes.title: Five years after launch, heartfelt indie Rakuen is getting a 'major update' and spin-off
notes.content: In 2017, indie developer and composer Laura Shigihara released Rakuen, a delightful adventure-RPG about a sick boy and his mother who travel back and forth between a whimsical fantasy land and the somewhat less whimsical hospital where he's staying. Now, Shigihara has announced that Rakuen is getting a significant update, and a new game in the same setting will be released next year... Read more.

notes.title: 🌸The Next Installment in the Rakuen Universe🌸
notes.content:
I am so incredibly thankful that in the past 5 years, so many people have experienced Rakuen. Thank-you for sharing your stories, for sending us fan art, and for all of the love and support throughout this whole process. It's more than I could have ever hoped for.

That's why today, I'm so excited to share that on March 23rd, 2023 we're releasing: 
[list]
[*]A major update for the original game that includes a new custom-built engine powered by Ebitengine, new art, animations, a Japanese localization done by 8-4 and...

[*]...[b]The next game in the Rakuen universe: Mr. Saitou!! [/b]
[/list]

[h1]Interested in submitting art, music or a Towel Cape Hero story?[/h1]
If you're still interested in submitting Rakuen related art or music, or a "Towel Cape Hero" story, you have until tomorrow (5/8) at 11:59pm PT to send them to supershigi at gmail. I will be choosing some to share live on stream!

[h1]What is a "Towel Cape Hero" story?[/h1]
A "Towel Cape Hero" story, is a story about someone doing something kind for you that really turned your day around. A stranger helping you carry groceries when you were exhausted, your mom sending you a care package, someone helping you when your car broke down, anything really! I really believe that everyone can be a hero through their kindness, whether it's a huge gesture, or something that seems like a random every day occurrence. Thanks so much for sharing these with me!

notes.title: How to Participate in the Rakuen Localization Beta!
notes.content:
Attention international fans: I'm excited to announce that thanks to the efforts of our wonderful fan translation teams, Rakuen has been localized into four new languages: Chinese (simplified), Italian, Korean, and Spanish! In order to bring you the best possible translations, we now humbly ask for your help...

For the next two weeks, the new language versions will be available to folks who already have Rakuen in their Steam library. We're looking for a few bilingual fans to help run through the game and report any errors they find. If you're interested in participating in the beta, please read the details below:

[h1]How to get the (Chinese/Italian/Korean/Spanish) version:[/h1]

Step 1: Right click Rakuen in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas tab -> select 'test - Bugfixes will be tested here first', in the dropdown menu.

Step 2: Under Properties choose the Language tab -> select the language you're testing, and then simply wait for the new Rakuen files to download!

[h1]How to Report Errors:[/h1]

When you're ready to submit your errors, we'd appreciate if you compile them into a single post on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/0/2741975115073247256/]Rakuen Translation thread.[/url]

We also have a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/8fhEqFq]Discord server[/url] where folks can discuss about the new language versions in real time under the #rakuen-chat channel.

[h1]Can I help translate Rakuen into (insert language)?[/h1]

That would be wonderful, thank-you! If you'd like to help us translate Rakuen into your language, please let us know at the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/0/2741975115073247256/]Translation thread[/url], or visit the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/8fhEqFq]Discord server[/url] for more details!
